summary: Master budgeting and forecasting techniques tailored for oil and gas operations. Join our training course to elevate your financial management skills today.
lede: Oil and gas cost models connect production, drilling and maintenance assumptions to budgets and forecasts. For finance analysts, asset controllers, production accountants and operations planners, this training supports building driver-based budgets, evaluating AFE economics, developing rolling scenarios and investigating variances with Excel models and Power BI dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who connect operational activity with financial planning across upstream, midstream, and downstream oil and gas environments. It suits experienced practitioners who already work with budgets, cost reports, production data, capital requests, or asset performance information and need a stronger method for forecasting under uncertainty.
modules: Integrated Oil and Gas Forecast Strategy
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: Working knowledge of budgeting, management reporting, cost control, production or project operations, and basic financial statements. Familiarity with oil and gas cost centres, production volumes, capital expenditure, or AFE processes is expected. No programming is required. Advanced concepts such as Monte Carlo analysis and AI-assisted forecasting are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application levels, while Excel modelling, variance analysis, and dashboard design receive hands-on practice.
